hazard_axis.bridge: none in Damage; Hazard delivers MESH75 = 15.096 x ((raw MESH / 2.54)^2)^0.206 per native pixel, capped at 203.2 mm, and zero damage below the 25.4 mm raw-MESH threshold; the smallest nonzero input is therefore 38.98 mm
hazard_axis.category_guardrail: NWS severe-hail labels and report counts are not damage inputs; a cell maximum or averaged MESH is not a point hail size.
hazard_axis.extrapolation_policy: diameter < 0 rejects; 0-203.2 mm straight lines between 1-mm knots; > 203.2 withholds

derivation_rationale.source_spine: Haag hail-damage threshold sizes by roofing material (AMS 2002 lab and field tables; Professional Roofing 2009 low-slope table; Haag 2010 metal rupture via CLM 2016), with roof-cover cost shares from FEMA Hazus 7.0 subassembly cost ratios (house, office) and judgment (warehouse).
derivation_rationale.adopted_form: per part, replacement probability lognormal in hail diameter (onset = 5%, full = 95%); unit DR = value-weighted, hail-facing-share-weighted sum; tabulated every 1 mm
derivation_rationale.why_not_swiss_radar_curve: Schmid et al. 2024 is a portfolio average over Swiss tile-roof buildings in a 1 km pixel (0.05% at 60 mm); owner choice D-HRE-01 keeps it as a cross-check.
derivation_rationale.parameter_tier_mix: Roof thresholds T3; house and office roof shares T2/T3 (Hazus); warehouse roof share, warehouse full-damage size, band reading and the whole walls-and-windows unit T4.
derivation_rationale.nri_check: See dossier §13 and NRI_CHECK; order-of-magnitude only.

legacy_comparison.legacy_arrays_used: none; the legacy Real Estate_Hail array is rejected (HRE-C018)
